attempts.text:
**The window starts in a long spine.** Columns 0 to 49, `rhoL` to `phoU` through the `ilv`, `rbs`, `atp`, `glm` and `pst` genes, are spine columns, carried by 92 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 25% of calls. The model names 96% of calls there on average, fewest at column 47 (`pstA`), 54%, and hesitates most at column 5 (`ppiC`), 0.79 bits.

**Then the graph opens.** Columns 50 to 57 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 46 to 69% of calls; the model names 84% of calls on average, fewest at column 51 (`bglF`), 79%, where it is also most hesitant, 0.72 bits. A second branch of 3 families runs through columns 55 to 57, carried by 10 to 19% of chromosomes, all shell: a hypothetical protein, a pentapeptide repeat-containing protein and `espY4`.

**A second spine follows.** Columns 58 to 73, `yieH` to `dnaN`, are spine columns, carried by 92 to 97% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 3 to 29% of calls. The model names 96% of calls on average, fewest at column 58 (`yieH`), 93%, and hesitates most at column 66 (`mnmE`), 0.34 bits.

**The window ends in fork and variable columns.** Columns 74 to 79 are in a region of plasticity in 8 to 59% of calls; the model names 93% of calls on average, fewest at column 78, 85%, where it is also most hesitant, 0.27 bits. Columns 74 to 78 are variable, carried by 20 to 90% of chromosomes, with `recF`, `gyrB`, `yidB` and `yidA` persistent and a hypothetical protein shell; column 79 is a fork, `dgoR` in 43% of chromosomes, with `yidX`, `dgoK` and `dgoA` beside it.

**Across the window the model names 95% of genes**, 0.22 bits on average, perplexity 1.3 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.79 against 0.15 bits, and names fewer genes, 80% against 96%.

label: rhoL
facts:
WINDOW: the rhoL window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor rhoL, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 4,340 to 4,419 from dnaA. Read in 539 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying rhoL once); 42,611 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 95% of genes, 0.22 bits on average (perplexity 1.3 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 37,054 calls, named 98%, 0.13 bits; shell 5,382 calls, named 77%, 0.75 bits; cloud 175 calls, named 13%, 3.71 bits. Outside an RGP 37,855 calls, named 96%, 0.15 bits; inside an RGP 4,756 calls, named 80%, 0.79 bits. Columns: 66 spine, 5 fork, 9 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.79 against 0.15 bits) and names fewer genes (80% against 96%); 4,756 of the 42,611 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 5 (ppiC) 0.79 bits, RGP 0%; column 51 (bglF) 0.72 bits, RGP 64%; column 56 (cbrC) 0.63 bits, RGP 64%. The 7 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 85%, 0.56 bits on average; the other 73 columns: named 96%, 0.19 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 50-57 (fork and variable columns), RGP 46-69%; the least: columns 0-49 (spine), RGP 0-25%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-49 (50 columns) spine: share 92-100%, all P, RGP 0-25%. Genes: rhoL, trxA, rhlB, gppA, rep, ppiC, ilvC, ilvY, ilvA, ilvD, ilvE, ilvM, ilvG "acetolactate synthase 2 catalytic s…", ilvX, ilvL, yifB "YifB family Mg chelatase-like AAA A…", maoP, hdfR, yieP "FadR/GntR family transcriptional re…", mdtD, rbsR, rbsK, rbsB, rbsC "ribose ABC transporter permease", rbsA, rbsD, kup, ravA, viaA, asnA "aspartate--ammonia ligase", asnC, mioC, mnmG, rsmG, atpI, atpB, atpE, atpF, atpH "F0F1 ATP synthase subunit delta", atpA, atpG, atpD, atpC, glmU "bifunctional UDP-N-acetylglucosamin…", glmS, pstS, pstC, pstA "phosphate ABC transporter permease…", pstB, phoU. named 54-100% (mean 96%), fewest named at column 47 (pstA), named 54%; most hesitant at column 5 (ppiC), 0.79 bits.
2. columns 50-57 (8 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 46-69%. named 79-90% (mean 84%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 51, named 79%, 0.72 bits.
   a second branch of 3 families through columns 55-57, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 10-19%, all S; the branch's families: "hypothetical protein", "pentapeptide repeat-containing protein", espY4
   50 fork: bglG S 67%; also "IS1-like element transposase" S 17%
   51 variable: bglF S 67%
   52 variable: bglB S 66%
   53 variable: bglH S 62% "carbohydrate porin"
   54 variable: yieL S 64% "alpha/beta hydrolase-fold protein"
   55 fork: yieK S 70% "glucosamine-6-phosphate deaminase"
   56 fork: cbrC S 47% "PF03691 family colicin E2 tolerance…"
   57 fork: cbrB S 72%
3. columns 58-73 (16 columns) spine: share 92-97%, all P, RGP 3-29%. Genes: yieH "6-phosphogluconate phosphatase", adeP, yieF "class I chromate reductase YieF", yieE "4'-phosphopantetheinyl transferase…", yidZ "HTH-type transcriptional regulator…", mdtL, tnaA, tnaC "tryptophanase leader peptide", mnmE, yidC "membrane protein insertase YidC", yidD "membrane protein insertion efficien…", rnpA, rpmH, "protein YsdD", dnaA "helix-turn-helix domain-containing…", dnaN. named 93-98% (mean 96%), fewest named at column 58 (yieH), named 93%; most hesitant at column 66 (mnmE), 0.34 bits.
4. columns 74-79 (6 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 8-59%. named 85-96% (mean 93%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 78, named 85%, 0.27 bits.
   columns 74-78 variable, share 20-90%, 4 P, 1 S: recF 90%, gyrB 87%, yidB "YidB family protein" 77%, yidA "Cof-type HAD-IIB family hydrolase" 80%, "hypothetical protein" 20%
   79 fork: dgoR S 43%; also yidX S 42%, dgoK S 22%, dgoA S 14%
